title: MED+250 active source-data reuse and provenance review ledger
summary: Redacted source-class inventory for the active medicine, consumer-product, pharmacy, contact, geospatial and central indicative-price data. Technical provenance is recorded, but publication and operational reuse still require a named data-owner decision.

checks.name: Active source-class inventory
checks.detail: The ledger covers every active source class identified by the import code, deployed migrations, source manifests and current catalogue research dataset.

checks.name: Amazon role and price exclusion
checks.detail: Amazon is recorded only as category, taxonomy and product-reference research. The audited 2,200-product dataset contains zero Amazon prices, and the database constraint requires Amazon price values to remain null.

checks.name: Central indicative-price provenance
checks.detail: All 128 populated central indicative prices are directly observed Rwanda catalogue references: 118 from Kasha Rwanda and 10 from Kigali Protein Store. They are informational, central and non-final.

checks.name: Published product-image source scope
checks.detail: No unverified product image is approved for public display. Image-source permission must be reviewed before any currently hidden image record can be approved.

checks.name: Immutable raw source snapshots
checks.detail: The active derived files are hashed, but retained raw snapshots are incomplete: the Rwanda FDA register source files are absent, the duty-roster manifest contains an unresolved source digest placeholder, and the Amazon research snapshot is local and ignored by Git.

checks.name: Licence and reuse permission decisions
checks.detail: A named data owner has not yet approved publication, operational reuse, attribution, retention, refresh cadence or withdrawal handling for every active source class.

checks.name: Data-owner review and signature
checks.detail: The accountable data owner must resolve blocked records, record one decision per source class, complete reviewer fields and provide the separate signed approval artifact.

source_records.source_class: Rwanda FDA pharmaceutical-product and licensed-pharmacy registers
source_records.operational_use: Medicine catalogue identity, regulatory status and authoritative pharmacy registry
source_records.publication_scope: Public medicine and licensed-pharmacy directory fields represented by the derived release CSV files
source_records.refresh_cadence: Refresh when Rwanda FDA publishes a newer authoritative register and re-run completeness plus duplicate review
source_records.withdrawal_action: Unpublish expired or withdrawn medicines and deactivate pharmacy records no longer present in the authoritative register

source_records.operational_use: Source-verified pharmacy phone and authorised WhatsApp contact candidates
source_records.publication_scope: Only governed business-contact availability; no personal contact evidence is included in this redacted ledger
source_records.refresh_cadence: Refresh for each published roster period and review exact pharmacy identity plus locality before promotion
source_records.withdrawal_action: Quarantine stale or disputed contacts and disable login use until reverified

source_records.source_class: Rwanda Military Medical Insurance pharmacy partner directory
source_records.operational_use: Secondary public evidence for pharmacy business contacts
source_records.publication_scope: Promoted exact pharmacy matches only; ambiguous or conflicting entries remain quarantined
source_records.refresh_cadence: Re-capture all directory pages before each release and re-run identity matching
source_records.withdrawal_action: Remove a promoted contact when the directory changes, the pharmacy disputes it or identity evidence becomes ambiguous

source_records.source_class: Government of Rwanda health-facility geospatial service
source_records.operational_use: Authoritative geospatial candidates for exact current FDA-licensed pharmacy matches
source_records.publication_scope: Approved pharmacy map locations only; exact coordinates are excluded from this redacted ledger
source_records.refresh_cadence: Re-query the government service and repeat exact name plus locality matching before location refresh
source_records.withdrawal_action: Remove location approval when source identity, locality, age or accuracy no longer meets the governed rule

source_records.source_class: Amazon.com category, taxonomy and product-reference research
source_records.operational_use: Consumer-product identity research and the requested 25 department-subcategory taxonomy pairs
source_records.publication_scope: Central product names and reference links only; Amazon pricing is prohibited and not present
source_records.refresh_cadence: Revalidate product identity, category relevance and availability before any material catalogue refresh
source_records.withdrawal_action: Unpublish affected consumer products when reuse is not approved, identity is uncertain or the reference is withdrawn

source_records.operational_use: Directly observed Rwanda reference values for 118 optional central indicative prices
source_records.publication_scope: Central informational From-RWF references only; not pharmacy prices, stock or final charges
source_records.refresh_cadence: Re-observe before price refresh and clear the reference when the source product is unavailable or stale
source_records.withdrawal_action: Clear the central indicative price and evidence URL without affecting product publication

source_records.source_class: Kigali Protein Store public product catalogue
source_records.operational_use: Directly observed Rwanda reference values for 10 optional central indicative prices
source_records.publication_scope: Central informational From-RWF references only; not pharmacy prices, stock or final charges
source_records.refresh_cadence: Re-observe before price refresh and clear the reference when the source product is unavailable or stale
source_records.withdrawal_action: Clear the central indicative price and evidence URL without affecting product publication

source_records.source_class: December 2025 Rwanda FDA pharmacy enrichment evidence
source_records.operational_use: Non-authoritative enrichment reconciled to the current May 2026 pharmacy registry
source_records.publication_scope: Governed pharmacy contact and map-reference fields only; current Rwanda FDA registry identity remains authoritative
source_records.refresh_cadence: Replace with current authoritative evidence when available and rerun registry reconciliation
source_records.withdrawal_action: Remove enrichment that conflicts with the current registry, pharmacy confirmation or newer official evidence

source_records.operational_use: Optional pharmacy map-search and place-reference links carried by the deployed enrichment snapshot
source_records.publication_scope: Directory links only; these records do not independently verify pharmacy GPS, contact ownership, stock or prices
source_records.refresh_cadence: Recheck links during pharmacy evidence refresh and never promote coordinates without the separate governed GPS review
source_records.withdrawal_action: Remove stale, disputed or mismatched links without affecting the authoritative pharmacy registry record

inactive_source_classes.source_class: Product imagery from unverified external sources
inactive_source_classes.reason: No such image is approved for public display. Rights verification is mandatory before publication.

inactive_source_classes.source_class: Amazon prices and currency-converted Amazon prices
inactive_source_classes.reason: Prohibited by the central catalogue model and verified absent from the active marketplace dataset.
Unsupported by the approved informational marketplace model.

completion_instructions: Retain or archive exact raw source snapshots where the ledger identifies a snapshot gap, and add their lowercase SHA-256 digests.
For each source record, record approved, rejected or approved-with-conditions plus licence, permission, attribution, publication scope, refresh and withdrawal terms.
Remove or replace derived data for every source that is rejected or cannot be lawfully reused.
Set pending_records and blocked_records to zero only after every record is resolved.
Add the named reviewer, role and timezone-qualified timestamp, set every check to passed, set status to complete and validate this artifact strictly.
Create the separate signed approval artifact, then add both validated artifacts and their SHA-256 values to data/launch-evidence.json.
